newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OLYMPICS-IRANIAN URGES SUPPORT FOR MOSLEM WOMEN.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-IRANIAN URGES SUPPORT FOR MOSLEM WOMEN.

text.p: Iranian Olympic Committee vice-president Faezeh Hashemi urged the International Olympic Committee (IOC) on Tuesday to support Moslem women.

"As the progressive trend of Olympism goes on, 500 million Moslem women are ignored because they maintain the moralities as stated in their holy religion Islam," Hashemi, daughter of Iranian president Hashemi Rafsanjani, told the World Conference on Woman and Sport.

"This isolation is in contrast to the Olympic movement. There has been nothing done to help include Moslem ladies during the past 100 years of IOC activities. You can no longer neglect 500 million Moslem ladies of the world.
"One-quarter of the world's women cannot do sport under the existing conditions. What is the problem of having sport competitions in accordance to our conditions?.
"Treating cultural practices disrespectfully will only lead to more isolation."
In Atlanta this year, shooter Lida Fariman became the first Iranian woman to take part in an Olympics since the Islamic revolution 17 years ago.
